title: Aap Abhi 1 Lakh Km/h Se Bhaag Rahe Ho!
idea: Even while sitting still, you are moving at about 107,000 km/h because Earth is orbiting the Sun at about 29.78 km/s.

lines.text: Aap abhi baithe ho, phir bhi 1 lakh km/h se bhaag rahe ho!
Dharti Sooraj ke chakkar har second lagbhag 30 kilometre ki speed se lagati hai.
Bullet train 320 pe chalegi, Dharti usse 300 guna se bhi zyada tez!
Mumbai se Delhi? Dharti ye doori sirf 38 second mein tay kar leti hai!
Ek din mein 25 lakh km, yaani Chaand tak 6 baar se zyada!
Phir bhi kuch mehsoos nahi hota! Bolo, aaj aapne kitna safar kiya?

youtube.title: Aap Baithe Baithe 1 Lakh Km/h Se Bhaag Rahe Ho! 🌍 #shorts
youtube.description:
Aap sofa pe baithe ho, phir bhi Dharti aapko 1,07,000 km/h ki speed se Sooraj ke chakkar lagwa rahi hai! 🚀
Mumbai se Delhi sirf 38 second mein, aur roz Chaand tak 6 baar se zyada ka safar 🤯
#shorts #space #factsinhindi #hinglishfacts #earth

facts.claim: Earth orbits the Sun at an average of 29.78 km/s, about 107,208 km/h
The Mumbai–Ahmedabad bullet train is designed for a top speed of 320 km/h (107,208 / 320 ≈ 335 times)
Mumbai to Delhi straight-line distance is about 1,137 km (1,137 / 29.78 km/s ≈ 38 seconds)
In one day Earth travels 29.78 × 86,400 ≈ 25.7 lakh km; the average Earth–Moon distance is 384,400 km, so that is about 6.7 times the distance to the Moon
